artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a landscape with buildings and tents below. The foreground features large buildings with pitched roofs and smoke coming from chimneys. Beyond the buildings, rows of tents are neatly arranged. The landscape extends to a horizon with trees, fencing, and hills. The sky is clear and light-colored. The color scheme is mostly sepia or brown tones, resembling early photographs.

artworks.title: Raising Column at Capitol Expansion
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald M. Costell, M.D. and the Estate of Marsha E. Swiss
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a large column being hoisted during the construction of a neoclassical building. In the image, a tall column is suspended from a crane structure bridging across an open courtyard. The building appears to be in an unfinished state, with piles of construction materials visible on the ground, such as bricks and stone blocks. The architecture features classical detailing with rows of windows and elaborately carved cornices. The background consists of taller building facades, each featuring rows of rectangular windows. The image is captured in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Corinth, Mississippi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg
artworks.description: The image shows a historic street scene with wooden buildings, horse-drawn carriages, and various signs, including one for "Secession Saloon" and others advertising groceries from "F.D. Barefoot & Co." and "HALE & DYER GROCERIES." The sepia-toned photograph captures a bustling street with dirt roads, showcasing the transportation and commerce of the late 19th century. Barrels and goods are visible, along with blurred elements suggesting motion and activity.

artworks.title: A Pastoral Landscape with Shepherds Playing a Viola and Panpipes
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache heightened with pen and ink and gold, pasted back onto page 1 of "Idylls and Other Texts"
artworks.dimensions:
page size: 31 x 20.3 cm (12 3/16 x 8 in.)
overall size (book closed): 32.4 x 21.6 cm (12 3/4 x 8 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Woodner Collection
artworks.description: This is an ornate manuscript page. The manuscript is adorned with decorative borders featuring floral patterns at the top of the page and a large letter "A" embellished with vines. The text, written in Greek, is in the center of the page. Below the script, the painting depicts a pastoral landscape. On the lower left, a seated man with a brown beard plays a stringed instrument, resembling a viola or a lute, while on the lower right, another person clad in blue plays panpipes. Surrounding them are various animals including sheep and goats on top of small green hills with a small river in the center. Trees rise along the sides of the page, and two small coats of arms hang from branches on either side.

artworks.title: Chartres Cathedral
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Patrick Montgomery
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts tall, elongated figures, likely saints or apostles, each adorned with intricate robes. The material appears to be stone with a weathered patina. The figures are in high relief against architectural columns. Each figure has a solemn expression and elongated proportions. The detailing includes halos and patterns on the robes and columns.

artworks.title: Presbytère de Conflans-sur-Anille (Rectory of Conflans-on-Anille)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Patrick Montgomery
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a rustic village house captured from a low angle. A pathway bordered by a stone wall leads towards the main building, which has brick walls, shuttered windows, and an adjacent peaked roof structure. Foliage and trees surround the house in a secluded setting. The composition lacks brushstrokes, suggesting it is a photograph. The color palette is earthy sepia tones, giving the image a vintage quality.

A body of water is on the right, reflecting the peaceful atmosphere. A small boat is seen in the distance. The artwork is rendered in a monochromatic palette, highlighting the etching technique's delicate line work and fine details.

artworks.title: Il Prete Ianni, Re d'Ethiopia (Prester John, King of Ethiopia)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man depicted from the waist up. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right with his body angled to one side, and his head turned towards the viewer. He has a full beard and mustache, with distinctive facial features, including slightly furrowed brows. His hair is covered by an elaborate turban or headpiece crowned with a small cross. The man is dressed in a heavy robe with a prominent collar, adding to his regal appearance. He holds a staff or scepter in his right hand. The background features a draped curtain on the right side and a heraldic shield featuring a cross on the left. The text below the engraving reads “IL PRETEIANNI, RE D’ETHIOPIA."

artworks.title: Chief Maungwudaus
artworks.creditLine: Alfred H. Moses and Fern M. Schad Fund
artworks.description: The image features a seated individual seen from the waist up in an upright position. The person has a composed expression with clearly defined facial features and long dark hair tucked under a feathered headdress. The headdress is intricately decorated. The individual is wearing a dark, patterned garment with a decorative necklace around their neck. They are holding a hatchet and another object in their hands. The backdrop is neutral, and the image is framed in an ornate gold and dark frame.

artworks.title: 2753. Gassing Wells
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an oil drilling site. The image features several tall wooden derricks dominating the background. The ground appears muddy or rough. Some buildings are visible in the distant background. The image is sepia-toned. The card mount surrounding the photograph indicates it was part of a stereoscopic view.

artworks.title: 42. Tarport & Limestone from B. B. & K. R. R.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated viewpoint. In the foreground, there are wooden oil derricks. In the background, there are hills and a valley. The color palette is mostly sepia tones, with various shades of brown, beige, and grey. The scene includes a townscape with small buildings blending into the hills. The level of detail in the buildings and derricks gives the image a documentary style.

artworks.title: 2757. Farrel Farm
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic industrial scene from an elevated angle. Wooden buildings with steeply pitched roofs are prominently displayed, constructed from weathered wooden planks. Tall, skeletal frameworks tower over the smaller buildings, indicating the presence of an oil rig operation. The horizon is obscured by a densely wooded hillside, framing the scene. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing textures and contrasts between the buildings and natural surroundings. The absence of color highlights the forms and structures, providing a historical glimpse into industrial architecture and its interaction with the environment.
